Guidance & outlook: And compliment that you met all the, I mean, parameters or the targets which are given and even in the current quarter also, there is a good credit growth of 3.77%, an overall annualized base is 22.75%, which is commendable.
INR 1,800 crores is expected to be done over the next one, one and half months.
ROA also around -- between 1.4% to 1.5%, we do expect in the foreseeable two to three quarters going forward.
Growth & demand: And we -- despite 13% or 14% growth in total deposit and 18% growth -- 17% growth in the retail term deposits, we have been able to maintain CASA of 41% on a consistent basis.
And looking at the loan book growth, last time we said 13% to 14% loan book growth.

Last 11 quarters of numbers if you see the things which are supposed to show a positive growth that is showing positive growth , and the areas where the numbers which are supposed to show negative growth, degrowth, it is happening accordingly.
Margins & costs: Bank has achieved the operating profit of INR 2,693 crores, registering a year -on-year growth of 14.21%.
Net interest margin global for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 is 3.37% with an increase of 12 bps as compared to 3.25% as of the last quarter March 2026.
For example, like our cost of deposit is about 4.7% and our cost of funds is 4.85%.
Capex & expansion: There is a major component of PSLC commission of INR 863 crores and good recovery.
So this PSLC and equally in the investment in the treasury book, also the profitability is there.
INR 476 crores will be normal exchange and commission, LC commission, BG commission, non-fund business plus locker rents, plus all other charges, demand drafts.
Risks & challenges: See, for IOB, this 10% decline is because of one bigger account around -- amounting to around INR 10,000 crores, which we -- in the first month of this financial year in the month of April itself, since pricing was not matching, so we came out of that arrangement.
If outside world, there are no uncertainties, there are no challenges, all of a sudden unexpected challenges , if everything remains smooth and constant.
If I go back to this INR 10,000 crores exposure, I'm sure you would have thought about whether we should continue the pricing competition.

Guidance & outlook: Deposit which has been a challenge for many of the other banks has grown by 18.03% against very modest targets given by you of 12 -13% or 14-15%.
And as per our calculation, we anticipate that the total impact of ECL, the new guideline which has been given by the regulator, it is going to be around 3000 crores.
Only thing which we have moderated is that till last year we were targeting and we were doing I will say recovery of more than 4000 crores every year.
Growth & demand: So far as business growth is concerned, we grew by 20.76% and it stood at Rs 6,78,614 crores as of 31st March 2026 when compared to Rs 5,61,958 crores as on 31st March 2025.
Advances grew by 24.16%, the total deposits grew by 18.03%, out of which retail term deposits stood at 17.81%, that is, Rs 1,836,01 crore when compared to Rs 1,55,846 crore as of 31st March '25.
Total deposits grew by 18.03% and retail term deposits grew by 17.81% and it stood at Rs 1,83,601 crore.
Margins & costs: Net interest margin stood at 3.21% as of 31st March 2026.
Operating profit grew by 15.40% and it stood at an all -time high of Rs 10,026 crores as of 31st March 2026, when compared to Rs 8,688 crores as of 31st March 2025.
Cost of funds stood at 5.09% as against 5.24% as at 31st March, 2025.
Risks & challenges: Regarding NPA management, there is a consistent improvement, consistent decline in GNPA.
Sir, the last thing is, there is IMD has forecast a 94% of the average rainfall going forward, which will at least put pressure on our agri -advances which are being shown as 1 lakh crore.
So even if we are growing at 20% or 21% in credit side, we do not see any challenge on liquidity side.
